admission.justification: An unbound model window or launcher could make token/compaction measurements describe a different actor than the one launched.

applicability: Prepared Hermes actor profiles admitted by the eval runner.
conditions: Provider/model/route and the prepared interpreter/launcher identity are bound before launch.
The compaction threshold derives from the resolver-observed model context window.
exclusions: Runtime installation or repair by the profile binder.

evidence: Frozen tree fd6462b85ba9d06f004e323384ea800f9aa5144a, base 59b01fb8f72a38d2d27f9c37b8b9ca2513fd3fa0; path bindings and source hashes in producer-manifest.json; Reviewer R4 and d229-repairs/report.md.
